name: Garment Care FAQ
summary: Questions about washing, storage and how to keep tailored garments looking new.

items.question: Can I machine wash a custom-tailored piece?
items.answer: We recommend against it for structured garments like suits and gowns — the canvas, lining and shaping can shift. Use our laundry service or a trusted dry cleaner familiar with tailored construction.

items.question: How often should I have a suit professionally pressed?
items.answer: Every 3–4 wears for regular use, or before and after long-term storage, keeps the structure and crease looking sharp.

items.question: How should I store traditional and beaded pieces?
items.answer: Store flat or on a padded hanger inside a breathable garment bag, away from direct sunlight, to protect embroidery and beadwork from crushing or fading.

items.question: Do you offer garment repair after normal wear and tear?
items.answer: Yes — our alterations bench handles button, lining and seam repairs on any garment, whether or not it was originally made by us.

seo.title: Garment Care FAQ
seo.description: Answers to common questions about washing, storing and maintaining tailored garments at Lipek Fashion.
